metadata.question: Does the green leaf area in China increase during 2017 compared to 2000?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS vegetation products (MOD13A2 or MCD43A4) or Landsat for leaf area analysis - MODIS LAI (Leaf Area Index) product MCD15A2H would be most appropriate - Compare 2000 vs 2017 for China - Need country boundary for China 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to filter out low-quality pixels - Cloud masking may not be necessary for annual composites - Focus on valid LAI measurements 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: LAI can legitimately be 0 in desert/barren areas - Check if result is None/NaN → C3 - Check if pixel count is 0 → C2 - Check if collection size is 0 → C1 - Compare mean LAI: if 2017 > 2000 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const china = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'China')); const geom = china.geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition using MODIS LAI product const lai2000 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD15A2H') .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .filterBounds(geom) .select('Lai'); const lai2017 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD15A2H') .filterDate('2017-01-01', '2017-12-31') .filterBounds(geom) .select('Lai'); const size2000 = lai2000.size().getInfo(); const size2017 = lai2017.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2000 Images: ${size2000}`); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}`); if (size2000 === 0 || size2017 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create annual composites (mean) const lai2000Mean = lai2000.mean().multiply(0.1); // Scale factor const lai2017Mean = lai2017.mean().multiply(0.1); // 4. Calculate statistics with pixel count const stats2000 = lai2000Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2017 = lai2017Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2000 = stats2000.Lai_mean; const count2000 = stats2000.Lai_count; const mean2017 = stats2017.Lai_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.Lai_count; console.log(`2000 Stats: Mean LAI=${mean2000}, Pixels=${count2000}`); console.log(`2017 Stats: Mean LAI=${mean2017}, Pixels=${count2017}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count2000 === 0 || count2017 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean2000 === null || mean2017 === null || isNaN(mean2000) || isNaN(mean2017) || mean2000 < 0 || mean2017 < 0 || mean2000 > 10 || mean2017 > 10) { console.log("Invalid LAI values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } const change = mean2017 - mean2000; console.log(`LAI Change: ${change.toFixed(4)} (${((change/mean2000)*100).toFixed(2)}%)`); if (mean2017 > mean2000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
